about: Clips for go run ./cmd/voice-check. {name} is her name from the config. Clips with a voice are made with Kokoro by -make; noise clips are made by the check itself. Recordings of real people can be added with their own entries; every .wav here stays out of git.

you.text: The north wind and the sun were disputing which was the stronger, when a traveller came along wrapped in a warm cloak. They agreed that the one who first succeeded in making the traveller take his cloak off should be considered stronger than the other.

her.text: Here is what I found for tomorrow. It should be mostly sunny in the morning, with some cloud later on, and a light breeze from the west. I will let you know if that changes.

clips.text: Hey {name}, can you add milk to the shopping list?
What do you think about that, {name}?
{name}, I was thinking... maybe we could plan the weekend.
I'll pick him up from school at three.
Claire and I are going out for dinner on Friday.
It should be sunny tomorrow, with a high of twenty degrees.
I'm {name}, and I'm always happy to help.
Did you see the game last night? It was brilliant.
Clark Kent was seen flying over the city late last night.
The clerk at the store gave me the wrong change again.
